name: XPUB Watch
description: Monitors multiple Bitcoin account xpub/ypub/zpub keys through your local Electrum Server.
Tracks receive/change addresses and UTXOs and raises an immediate event when a known UTXO is spent.
Tracks mempool/confirmed state and confirmation counts, identifies spending TXIDs, and adds transaction explorer links.
Supports optional ntfy/Gotify/Telegram notifications. Never enter a seed phrase, private key, PIN or BIP39 passphrase.

app_page_content.heading: Security
content: Watch-only: add one or more account xpub/ypub/zpub keys.
Never enter a seed phrase, private key, hardware-wallet PIN or BIP39 passphrase.
All blockchain queries go to the Electrum Server running on this MyNode.
The app is served through MyNode HTTPS on port 5116.
